6.description: Anyone who has been mind controlled in the last 20 seconds, has received The Prophets Madness in the last 30 seconds, or is the main target of Skeram or his mirages should no longer be mind controllable and is not a viable target for The Prophets Madness.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Applied some changes to Skeram to make his clones less erratic, this should fix a lot of major issues with Skeram.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Removed the extra abilities on Skerams illusions, normalized their physical damage and increased it by 25%.

6.description: Corrected an issue where if Skeram was trying to look for a target to mind control who didnt have The Prophets Madness, he would not specify that target could not be his tank.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Skerams Mind Control can no longer by used by his mirages.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: To make the Ossirian encounter more learnable and less frustrating/unfair. Rather than Ossirian randomizing his abilities on pull, he will now split the abilities he used before in phases. You can now know exactly what to expect each pull, and you can know that his abilities will switch at 50% health. A majority of his heavy AoE abilities take place in the first 50% to avoid 1-shotty behavior when his enrage begins.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Increased Ossirians health pool by 2x.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: With the removal of Ossirians Supreme buff, given how damage increases are not additive, we buffed the Everexpanding Void debuff to increase his damage by 20% per stack from 10%. This should still result in a net decrease in his peak damage from before.

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Added a tooltip to the Everchanging Void debuff to better show that the creature changes its abilities as you progress through the fight. (This is to be applied with our next patch release)

6.author: SpringForce(196211299435282432)
6.description: Nerfed Void Singularity ability damage by 30% across the board (Everchanging Void).
